record.name: Myanmar
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. State sources report a National Artificial Intelligence Development Department and work on a draft National AI Strategy and Policy, but no body with a mandate to evaluate advanced models and no commitment to a safety institute.

next_check.reason: Check the National Artificial Intelligence Development Department mandate and a readable full or adopted AI strategy for responsibilities for evaluating advanced models.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English search did not identify a qualifying institute or institute-specific commitment. Reviewed state sources identify the National Artificial Intelligence Development Department and policy drafting. The department's development role and WAICO participation do not establish evaluation of advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded my query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Indexed results were sparse or noisy; the recorded language search does not establish complete coverage. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The ISEAS multi-country strategy sentence supplies general policy context, not substantive Myanmar institute-status evidence. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: State sources describe a National AI Development Department and strategy/policy drafting. The reviewed material does not assign a mandate to evaluate advanced models.

record.notes: Opened and read the Burmese Ministry of Information announcement dated 19 February 2025 (https://www.moi.gov.mm/news/67356), which describes strategy/policy drafting; the Ministry of Foreign Affairs account dated 29 August 2025 of AI policy work and AI-powered metrology cooperation (https://www.mofa.gov.mm/en/dr-aung-zeya-deputy-minister-of-science-and-technology-of-myanmar-and-consul-general-of-myanmar-attended-2025-asean-oriented-standardization-cooperation-forum-27-8-2025/); and Myanmar Digital News dated 22 July 2026 (https://mdn.gov.mm/en/pyidaungsu-hluttaw-weighs-ordinance-continuation-waico-signing), saying the ministry "has established the National Artificial Intelligence Development Department". The latter is evidence of an existing AI development body, not a precise founding date or evaluation mandate. Its international-cooperation discussion on AI misuse does not assign model evaluation to the department. No qualifying commitment, formal institute proposal or government study of an AISI was identified. A search lead for a version-5 draft strategy on OpenDevelopment Myanmar yielded only metadata; its one attempt to retrieve a text copy failed, so the full draft was not reviewed. The old claim that no national AI strategy work was found is superseded. Official state sources are used for what they announce, without treating general AI development or metrology as evaluation of the safety of advanced models.

related_bodies.name: National Artificial Intelligence Development Department
related_bodies.role: It is reported as established under the Ministry of Digital Development and Communications by July 2026 to accelerate AI technology development; no mandate to evaluate advanced models was found.
